# heed

> Embeddable, no-install, framework-agnostic end-user feedback / bug-report / feature-request capability with a pluggable backend (standalone; optional enlace add-on)


## Pages in this subsection

- [heed](heed.html.md): heed — embeddable, no-install, framework-agnostic end-user feedback.
- [heed.base](heed.base.html.md): Domain model for heed — the single source of truth shared by widget and backend.
- [heed.config](heed.config.html.md): Configuration for the heed backend (smart defaults; keyword-only).
- [heed.images](heed.images.html.md): Neutralise uploaded screenshots before they are stored (issue #15).
- [heed.ingest](heed.ingest.html.md): The ingest layer — build a Report from a submission and route it to a sink.
- [heed.routing](heed.routing.html.md): Where a report goes: server-side site resolution and moderation (holding state).
- [heed.security](heed.security.html.md): Public-endpoint hardening (the ingest endpoint is unauthenticated and hostile).
- [heed.sinks](heed.sinks.html.md): Sinks: pluggable report destinations (strategy pattern).
- [heed.sinks.base](heed.sinks.base.html.md): The sink abstraction — where a report goes (strategy pattern).
- [heed.sinks.github](heed.sinks.github.html.md): A sink that turns a report into a GitHub issue.
- [heed.sinks.store](heed.sinks.store.html.md): A sink that persists reports into a Mapping (the default, dependency-free sink).
- [heed.storage](heed.storage.html.md): Storage helpers — dol-backed stores for reports and binary attachments.
